title: Search available Agent profiles
goal: Help users find an installed Agent profile by name, description, identifier, or declared Skill.
context: The Agents screen lists all available profiles. As the profile catalog grows, local search and a clear no-match state make selection faster without changing runtime behavior.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Agent selection, team mode, runtime routing, permissions, or Skill execution semantics.
Do not persist the search query or add network access.
Do not modify Agent manifests or role blueprint definitions.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance without testing a real iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: Available Agent profiles can be filtered by case-insensitive name, description, ID, or declared Skill ID.
A clear-search control appears only when the query is non-empty.
The UI shows filtered count versus total profiles.
No matching results and an empty Agent store have distinct explanatory states.
Selecting a filtered profile continues to use the existing selection behavior and remains disabled while a task is running.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on final PR head.
Verify search, clear, no-match, and profile selection on a physical iPhone.
recovery: If the search field adds too much vertical height on small screens, compact the count row without removing filtering or empty-state feedback.
